retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, gritty urban scene featuring a central masked figure flanked by models, set against a backdrop of corporate skyscrapers and luxury vehicles with aggressive, distressed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A chaotic, multi-layered composition blending realistic photography with comic-style line work and heavy textures. It features a central trio—a skull-masked man in a suit and two women—positioned behind a bright yellow supercar. The background is a teal-tinted cityscape with a large corporate seal reflected in glass, all overlaid with jagged, blood-red and yellow distressed text.
coreVisualRelationships: The yellow supercar in the foreground acts as a bright visual entry point.
The central trio forms a vertical pillar of focus against the horizontal car.
The large red title text arches over the subjects, framing them within the urban environment.
The teal sky and building glass contrast sharply with the warm reds and yellows of the car and text.
coreInvariants: Distressed, hand-drawn quality to all typographic elements
A teal and orange/yellow color split
Halftone or comic-style shading on skin and surfaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The supercar occupies the bottom third; the central trio is mid-ground, scaled to appear dominant; the background skyscrapers fill the remaining upper two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow hood of the car at the bottom left and the large red title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the yellow car, move up to the central figures, and then follow the arched title text across the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with detail, texture, and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow (Foreground car and secondary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blood Red (Primary title and corner accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow and red elements against a desaturated, dark-valued teal environment.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed sans-serif with irregular baselines
letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent letter heights and widths to create a frantic energy
Heavy black outlines or drop shadows to separate text from busy backgrounds
Simulated ink bleed and splatter effects
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'E' and 'F' have elongated, sharp horizontal bars
The 'O' and 'U' characters are often squashed or tilted
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine the aggressive main title with a cleaner, blocky sans-serif for secondary info and a script-like 'handwritten' font for small callouts.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, hand-drawn energy of the main title
Matches the secondary 'American Capitalist' style text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty urban scene with a yellow supercar in the foreground, a man in a suit with a skull mask and two women in black dresses in the mid-ground, and teal-tinted skyscrapers in the background. Apply a comic-book halftone filter and high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, arched, distressed red lettering across the top. Add secondary yellow block text in the upper left and right corners. Ensure all text has a heavy black outline to pop against the background.

verificationChecks: Is the typography sufficiently distressed and jagged?
Does the teal/yellow/red color scheme dominate?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep black shadows?
Are the figures outlined to separate them from the background?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between text and background.
Ensure the 'torn' texture is visible on the letter edges.
Confirm the supercar is the brightest element in the lower frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Gritty Urban Photography] + [Comic Book Halftone Filter] + [Arched Distressed Typography] + [Teal/Orange Color Grade].
